title: COMMAND BLESSINGS THIS  WEEK AND WATCH YOUR LIFE CHANGE
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. Lift your hands wherever you are and just bless the name of the Lord. We give you praise, we give you honor, we give you glory. You are the ancient of days, the one who was and is and is to come. There is none like you in all the earth and there is none like you in the heavens above. We worship you this morning. We celebrate your faithfulness. We celebrate your mercies that are new every single morning. Great is your faithfulness, oh Lord. Great is your faithfulness. Father, we thank you for life. We thank you for the privilege of seeing another week. Not everyone who slept last night woke up this morning. [music] Not everyone who made plans is here to execute those plans. But you, in your mercy, you in your kindness, you opened our eyes and brought us into a brand new day and a brand new week. Father, we are grateful. We are deeply, deeply grateful. Now, I want you to settle your heart this morning because what God wants to do through this time of ministration is not ordinary. There is a reason the spirit of God has drawn you here. There is a reason the Lord has caused [music] your path to align with this moment. It is not by accident, it is not by coincidence. God is intentional. God is deliberate. And the Bible says that the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. Your step to this place, your step to this moment, it was ordered. Heaven arranged it. And I want you to receive what the Lord has for you with both hands. I want to begin in the book of Deuteronomy chapter 28 and verse two. I want you to hear what the spirit of the Lord is saying. The scripture says, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shall hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God." Now, there is something extraordinary about that verse that many people gloss over. The Bible did not say you shall chase blessings. The Bible did not say you shall pursue blessings. It says, "Blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee." The imagery there is profound. The blessings are the ones in motion. The blessings are the ones running and they are running after you. They are chasing you down. They are tracking you. They know your name and they know your address and they will not stop until they find you. But the condition, the Bible says if thou shall hearken onto the voice of the Lord thy God. There is a connection between obedience and the activation of commanded blessings. There is a connection between alignment with God and the manifestation of divine favor. You cannot disconnect the blessing from the blesser. You cannot have the hand of God without having the face of God. Many people want the benefits of a relationship they have not cultivated. But those who draw near to God, those who hearken, those who position themselves in the place of obedience and surrender, these are the ones the blessings overtake. Now, I want you to understand something this morning. We are not just talking about blessings in the generic sense. We are talking about commanded blessings. There is a difference between a blessing that happens and a blessing that is commanded. When God commands a blessing, it carries divine authority, it carries supernatural momentum, it cannot be stopped by hell. It cannot be intercepted by principalities. It cannot be hindered by the economy of any nation. When God opens his mouth and commands, the entire universe obeys. Psalm 133:3 says, "There the Lord commanded the blessing, even life forevermore." That word commanded is not passive. That word commanded is an executive order from the throne room of God. And when that order is released over your life, every gate must open, every wall must come down, every delay must end, and every dry season must give way to [music] a harvest. I want you to understand the nature of commanded blessings this morning because I believe with everything in me that this is your week. Not just any week. This is the week that marks a turning. This is the week that marks a shift. This is the week where you will look back a year from now and say it was that week, it was that morning, it was that prayer, it was that time I positioned myself before the Lord. That was when everything changed. The Bible in the book of Genesis chapter 1 tells us that in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth and we know the story, everything was formless and void. Darkness was upon the face of the deep. But notice what happened next. The spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters and then God spoke. He said, "Let there be light." And there was light. Now, I want you to catch the sequence. The spirit moved first before the word was spoken. Meaning the atmosphere was first charged by the presence of the Holy Spirit and then the creative word of God landed and produced results. That is the prophetic pattern for this morning. The spirit of God is moving over your situation right now. The spirit of God is moving over that marriage. The spirit of God is moving over that business. [music] The spirit of God is moving over that health challenge, over that financial matter, over that relationship, over that career. The spirit is moving. And then we are going to speak the word over it. And when the spirit and the word agree, when the work of God and the rhema of God converge, creation happens. Things that did not exist begin to exist. Things that were dead begin to live. Things that were shut begin to open. I am telling you this is your moment. Do not let this morning pass without receiving something. Do not let the familiarity of prayer and worship make you passive. Come alive in your spirit. Come alive to what God is doing. Engage, because engaged faith is the kind of faith that heaven responds to. The Bible says that without faith it is impossible to please God. And faith is not passive. Faith leans in. Faith reaches out. Faith says, "If I may but touch the hem of his garment, I shall be whole. That woman with the issue of blood, she did not sit in the back of the crowd and hope for the best. She pressed. She pressed through impossibility. She pressed through shame. She pressed through the crowd. She pressed through 12 years of disappointment. And she got to Jesus and she touched him and virtue flowed. Virtue that had been stored up, virtue that was reserved, virtue that had her name on it, it flowed. The moment she pressed into contact with the source. So, I want you this morning to press. Press in your heart. Press in your prayer. Press in your expectation. Press in your faith. Because I [music] promise you the Lord has virtue reserved for you. There is a specific grace with your name on it. There is a breakthrough that has been waiting for this moment. Now, let me take you to another scripture because I want to build on this. Go with me to Numbers chapter 6 and verses 24 through 26. This is the Aaronic blessing. This is a blessing that God himself offered. God did not allow man to design this blessing. He said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, tell him what to say over the people." God scripted the blessing. The Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace. Now, what is happening in that scripture is extraordinary. God is not telling Aaron to ask for blessings on behalf of the people. God is commanding Aaron to release blessings. There is a difference. When you ask, you are in the posture of a beggar. When you release, you are in the posture of an ambassador, an authorized agent of heaven. And God said, "I want my servants to speak like authorized agents, releasing commanded blessings over the people." And then the verse that follows, verse 27, says, "And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel and I will bless them." Did you catch that? They shall put my name upon the children of Israel. When the name of God is put upon you, when the name of God is spoken over you, it is not just words. The name of God carries the weight of his character, the weight of his power, the weight [music] of his covenant, the weight of his ability. When Jehovah Jireh is declared over your provision, the God who provides comes into that situation. When Jehovah Rapha is declared over your body, the God who heals comes into that condition. When Jehovah Nissi is declared over your battles, the Lord your banner, the God of victory comes into that warfare. The name is not ceremonial. The name is functional. The name is operational. And this morning we are going to call upon the name of the Lord over every area of your life. I want to also take you to Isaiah chapter 45 and verse 2 and 3. I love this passage. God is [music] speaking to Cyrus, but the principle transcends Cyrus. God says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. And I will give thee the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places that thou mayest know that I the Lord which call thee by thy name am the God of Israel." Now, there are several layers in that passage. First, God says, [music] "I will go before thee." Not I will walk beside thee. Not I will follow behind thee. I will go before thee. This means before you arrive at Monday, God is already there. Before you arrive at the meeting, God is already there. Before you arrive at the negotiation, God is already there. Before you arrive at the hospital, God is already there. He is the God who goes before, and because he goes before, the crooked places are made straight before your feet get there. The gates of brass, those impossible barriers, [music] those institutional walls, those generational blockages, they are broken before you arrive. You just walk into what has already been done. And then he says he will give you the treasures of darkness and the hidden riches of secret places. Now, what are the treasures of darkness? These are blessings that have been hidden. These are resources that have been concealed. These are connections, divine [music] connections, that have been stored in places you cannot naturally see. But God, who sees in the dark, who knows what is hidden, who has access to every secret place, he says he will bring those things out and release them to you. This means your greatest blessings may not come from sources you are currently looking at. God has hidden riches in places you have not yet looked. He has resources in pipelines you have not yet discovered. He has doors in walls you did not know existed. And the reason he does all of this is stated at the end of the verse, that you may know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel. [music] God blesses you so that your testimony becomes a revelation of who he is. Your breakthrough is not just for you. Your miracle is not just for your comfort. When God does something extraordinary in your life, it becomes a declaration to your generation, to your family, to your community, that this God is real, that this God is faithful, that this God still moves. Your story is somebody else's faith and somebody else's courage. So, receive your blessing not just for yourself, but for the testimony that will come out of it. Now, I want to talk about something that I believe is very important for this week. I want to talk about divine alignment. Because one of the things I've come to understand is that many blessings are not delayed because God is unwilling. [music] They are delayed because the recipient is not in alignment. Alignment means you are in the right position to receive what heaven is releasing. Think about a satellite dish. The satellite is transmitting a signal constantly. The signal does not stop. The signal does not get tired. But if the dish is not aligned correctly, you will [music] not receive the signal. The problem is not with the transmission. The problem is with the positioning of the receiver. And God is always transmitting. The blessings of God are always flowing. The mercies of God are always available. The grace of God is always sufficient. But there are times when we need a realignment. There are times when we need to position ourselves correctly so that what heaven is releasing can land in our lives. How do you align? The scriptures give us several keys. The first is the fear of the Lord. Psalm 25:14 says the secret of the Lord is with them that fear him. When you fear the Lord, you come into an intimacy with God where he begins to share secrets with you. He tells you where to go, what to do, whom to connect with, when to act, and when to wait. The fear of the Lord is not being afraid of God. It is being in such awe of God, being so conscious of his greatness and his holiness that you find yourself naturally surrendering to his wisdom and his will. The fear of the Lord makes you sensitive to his voice and sensitive to his leading. And when you follow his leading, you walk into pathways of blessing that you could never have found on your own. The second key to alignment is honor. Proverbs 3:9 [music] says, "Honor the Lord with thy substance and with the firstfruits of all thine increase." There is a principle in the kingdom called the principle of firstfruits. Whatever you honor, you attract. Whatever you celebrate, you draw near to you. When you honor God with your resources, when you honor God with your time, when you honor God with your gifts, you are telling heaven that God is first in your life. And when God is first, everything else comes into order. The scripture says, "Seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, [music] and all these things shall be added unto you." The keyword is added. When God is first, the blessings are added. They are attached to the pursuit of the kingdom. [music] You do not have to chase them separately. They come as a consequence of seeking God. The third key to alignment is partnership with the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the one who knows the deep things of God. First Corinthians 2:10 says, "The Spirit searcheth all things, [music] yea, the deep things of God." The Holy Spirit has inside knowledge. He knows what the Father is doing. He knows what is available in heaven for you. He knows which door to lead you to. He knows which person to connect you with. He knows which decision will unlock your season. And when you are led by the Spirit, when you yield to the Holy Spirit, when you make the Holy Spirit your partner in life, and in ministry, and in business, and in relationships, you have access to the most superior intelligence in the universe. There is no strategic consultant on earth who can give you the counsel that the Holy Spirit gives. There is no financial advisor who can give you the insight that the Holy Spirit gives. When the Holy Spirit says, "Buy," [music] you buy. When he says, "Wait," you wait. When he says, "Go," you go. And every step taken in obedience to the Holy Spirit is a step taken toward your destiny. Now, let me bring all of this together because I want us to move into the place of prayer. I want you to understand that prayer is not just speaking words into the air. Prayer is engaging the supernatural. Prayer is the mechanism through which the intentions of heaven are pulled into the experiences of earth. The Bible says in Matthew 6:10, "Thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven." There is something that is true in heaven that has not yet manifested on earth, and prayer is the bridge. Prayer is what pulls the heavenly reality into the earthly experience. When you pray, you are not informing God of something he does not know. When you pray, you are agreeing with what God has already purposed. You are saying, "Lord, what you have decided in eternity, let it be seen in time. What you have written in my book before I was formed, let it come to pass in my days. And when you pray with the word, when your prayer is saturated with scripture, when you are not just praying your feelings, but you are praying the promises, you are praying from a position of authority. Because the word of God is what gives your prayer weight. The word of God is what makes your prayer immovable. When the enemy comes to challenge your prayer, he cannot challenge the word of God. The word of God is settled in heaven. Psalm 119:89 says, "Forever, oh Lord, thy word is settled in heaven." What is settled in heaven cannot be unsettled by hell. So, I want you right now to position yourself. If you are seated, sit up. Come to a place of alertness in your spirit. If you are able to lift your hands as a physical expression of your surrender and your expectation, and let us enter into the presence of the Lord together. Let us come boldly before the throne of grace as Hebrews 4:16 instructs us. Not timidly, not with shame, not with guilt, but boldly. Because we have a high priest who understands our weaknesses, who was touched with the feeling of our infirmities, who was in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin. We come through him, through his blood, through his name, and we come boldly. Before we go into prayer, I want to encourage you to share this with someone. There is somebody in your life right now who needs this word. There is somebody in your contact list, in your family, in your church, in your circle, who needs to be [music] in this atmosphere this morning. The scripture says in Proverbs 11:25 that he that watereth shall also be watered himself. [music] When you share this blessing with someone, you are not losing anything. You are multiplying. You are activating a law of the kingdom that says the one who gives, receives. The one who blesses is blessed. So, please, before we go deeper, share this with someone who needs to hear from God this morning. Let this word reach as many lives as possible. Let this prayer cover as many people as possible because there is no shortage in God. There is room at this altar for every single person. God does not have limited blessings. His hand is not shortened. His ear is not heavy that it cannot hear. So, share this and let us water as many lives as we can. Now, Father, we come before you. We come before you with Thanksgiving in our hearts. We come before you with praise on our lips. We come before you acknowledging that you alone are God. That there is none beside you. That you are the alpha and the omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end. Father, we thank you for this new week. We thank you for fresh mercies. We thank you for another opportunity to believe, another opportunity to trust, another opportunity to see your glory manifest in our lives. Father, I come in agreement with every person connecting with this [music] word this morning. Every person watching. Every person listening. Every person whose heart has been drawn to this time of prayer. I come in agreement with their faith. I come in agreement with their expectation. And Father, I declare that none of them shall go away empty. None of them shall leave this place the way they came. For your word says that they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary. They shall walk and not faint. Father, renew every person connecting with this prayer right now. Renew their strength. Renew their hope. Renew their passion. Renew their fire. Renew their confidence in you. Now, Father, we come to the matter of blessings. Commanded blessings. Father, we know that you are the God who commands [music] blessings. We know that your blessing does not come by human effort alone. Your blessing does not come by the wisdom of man. Your blessing comes [music] by your sovereign command. So, Father, in the name of Jesus, we are asking you to open your mouth over our lives this morning. We are asking you to speak the word over our destinies. We are asking you to command the blessing over our families, over our finances, over our health, over our careers, over our businesses, over our ministries. Father, command the blessing. Let the blessings that Deuteronomy 28 speaks about be activated in our lives this day. Let the blessing [music] in the city and the blessing in the field both Let the blessing in our coming in and our going out be evident to all those around us. Father, let those who see us be able to say that this is a people whom the Lord has blessed. Let it be visible. Let it be tangible. Let it be undeniable. Father, in the name of Jesus, I declare that every curse that [music] has been spoken over the destinies of the people hearing this word is broken right now. Every word of negativity, every pronouncement of failure, every ancestral decree that has been working against progress and advancement, I break it in the name of Jesus. The Bible says that as the bird by wandering and the swallow by flying, so the curse [music] causeless shall not come. Father, we declare that we are under the blood of Jesus. We are covered. We are shielded. We are protected. And no weapon formed against us shall prosper. And every tongue that rises against us in judgment, we condemn. For this is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of you. Now, Father, we speak to every mountain in the lives of your people this morning. Every mountain of stagnation, every mountain of lack, every mountain of sickness, every mountain of broken relationships, every mountain of confusion and uncertainty, we speak to you this morning. Jesus said in Mark chapter 11, verse 23, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, "Be thou removed and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he said shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever [music] he said." So, we are speaking mountain of financial stagnation, we speak to you this morning. We say be removed. Be cast into the sea. You have no place in the lives of God's people. The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof. The world and they that dwell therein. God owns everything. He owns the cattle on a thousand hills. He owns the silver and the gold and he said he will withhold no good thing from them that walk uprightly. [music] So, mountain of lack, hear the word of the Lord this morning. Your time is up. Your assignment is terminated in the name of Jesus. Mountain of sickness and infirmity, hear the word of the Lord. By his stripes we were healed. That is past tense. That healing was purchased at Calvary. That healing was secured when Jesus said it is finished. The price has been paid, the provision has been made and we receive our healing this morning. Every organ in our bodies, every cell, every system, every tissue, every bone, every nerve, come into alignment with the word of God. Come into alignment with the finished work of Calvary. Sickness, you are a defeated enemy. Disease, you are a trespasser. You have no legal right. You have no covenant claim. We are temples of the Holy Spirit and the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead dwells in us and he's quickening our mortal bodies right now in the name of Jesus. Father, I speak to destiny now. I speak to purpose and assignment. Father, there are men and women hearing this word this morning who have been carrying a dream for years. They have been carrying a vision that you put in their hearts. They have been carrying a burden for a purpose that only you could give. And seasons of delay, seasons of disappointment, seasons of discouragement have made them question whether that dream was real. Father, I ask you today by the fire of the Holy Spirit, reignite that dream. Reignite that vision. Blow on those embers because you are not a God who gives a vision and then abandons it. You are not a God who calls and then withdraws. You are faithful. You who began a good work in them will complete it. You will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. And Father, I declare that this week marks the beginning of a new chapter in the unfolding of their destiny. Father, I speak to open doors now. Lord Jesus, you said in Revelation 3:8, "I have set before thee an open door and no man can shut it. I have set before thee an open door." Father, open doors of opportunity that have been closed. Open doors of favor that have been shut. Open doors of divine connections, strategic relationships, covenant partnerships. Open doors of new income streams. Open doors of academic breakthrough. Open doors of ministerial expansion. Open doors in nations and territories. Lord Jesus, you have the key of David. What you open, no man can shut. What you shut, no man can open. Open the doors, Lord. Open the doors this morning. Let the right people come in and let the wrong people go out. Let the right opportunities come in and let every counterfeit be removed. Open the doors in the name of Jesus. Father, I speak to finances now because I know that the people of God are not supposed to be in lack. 3 John verse 2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth." This is the wish of God. This is the desire of the Father. Prosperity in every dimension. Father, let abundance flow to your people this morning. Let the grace for wealth creation come upon them. Let the wisdom to multiply resources rest upon them. Let divine ideas, inspired strategies, supernatural creativity come to them. Let them find solutions that nations are willing to pay for. Let them carry value that the marketplace is desperate to access. Father, let prosperity overtake them. Let increase overtake them. Let the blessings come on them and overtake them just as your word has declared. Father, I speak to relationships now. Lord, some of your people are in a season of loneliness. Some are in marriages that have lost their warmth, their intimacy, their joy. Some are in friendships that have turned toxic. Some are waiting for a life partner. Father, move on behalf of every one of them. Into marriages that are struggling, I send the fire of the Holy Spirit. I send the love of God. I speak restoration. I speak renewed affection. I speak communication where there has been silence. I speak forgiveness where there has been bitterness. I speak healing where there has been wounds. Let the God who is the author of marriage come and do what only he can do. And for those who are waiting for a life partner, Father, let divine alignment happen. Let the right person find them. Let the covenant connection that you have ordained from before the foundation of the earth [music] be established in this season. In the name of Jesus. Father, I speak to the children. Lord, I cover every child that belongs to the families of the people hearing this word. I cover them with the blood of Jesus. No weapon fashioned against them shall prosper. No plan of the enemy against their education shall stand. No assault against their destiny shall succeed. I declare that they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord and their offspring with them. I declare that goodness and mercy shall follow them all the days of their lives. I declare that they shall be mighty in the land. That the generation of the upright shall be blessed. Father, preserve their innocence. Protect their future and let them fulfill every purpose you have written in their book in the name of Jesus. Father, I pray for grace now. Lord, there are things that people have been trying to do in their own strength that they have not been able to accomplish. There are areas where human effort has reached its limit. Father, let your grace fill in where human effort has failed. Let your grace accomplish what willpower could not. Let your grace open what strategy could not. For your word says, "Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit," said the Lord of hosts. Father, release the spirit of grace and supplication over every person hearing this word. Let them access a dimension of grace that they have not previously accessed. Let grace make them sufficient for every assignment. Let grace give them access to every resource. Let grace be their testimony this week in the name of Jesus. Father, I speak to the spirit of fear now. For you have not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. I come against every spirit of anxiety, every spirit of worry, every spirit of dread, every panic [music] attack, every phobia, every torment of the mind. I bind you in the name of Jesus. You have no authority. You have no place. The blood of Jesus has purchased our peace. The prince of peace has come and he said, "My peace I give unto you, not as the world giveth give I unto you." Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. Father, let supernatural peace come upon every person hearing this word this morning. The peace that passes all understanding that will guard their hearts and their minds through Christ Jesus. Let that peace come and settle and rest and abide. Father, I speak to every form of delay and I declare that it is over. The Bible says that hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when the desire comes, it is a tree of life. Father, the desire is coming. >> [music] >> The manifestation is coming. The breakthrough is coming. The answer is coming. Not next year, not next decade, this season, this month, this week. Father, let the things that have been delayed begin to arrive. Let the things that have been pending begin to manifest. Let the things that have been in transit begin to land. I declare that the season of delays over and the season of manifestation has begun in the name of Jesus. Father, I speak prophetically now over the new week. I declare Monday is blessed in the name of Jesus. I declare Tuesday is blessed, Wednesday is blessed, Thursday is blessed, Friday is blessed, Saturday is blessed, Sunday is blessed. >> [music] >> Every single day of this week carries divine favor. Every day carries divine opportunity. Every day carries divine encounters. Father, let your people go into this week knowing that they are covered, knowing that they are graced, knowing that they are favored, knowing that the Lord of hosts goes before them, knowing that his angels are encamped round about them to deliver them. I declare that this week you will encounter favor you did not earn. You will encounter open doors you did not knock on. You will encounter provision that surprises you. You will encounter divine connections that change the trajectory of your story. You will encounter breakthroughs that make you look back and say this had to be God. I declare it in the name of Jesus and I refuse to cancel this declaration. Father, I speak to every satanic agenda for the week ahead and I scatter it. Every plan of the enemy to steal, kill, and destroy, I scatter it by the blood of Jesus. Every assignment against the peace of God's people, I abort it. Every ambush that has been set up against them, I dismantle it in the name of Jesus. The hedge of God is around them, the fire of God is around them, the angels of God are around them and greater is he that is in them than he that is in the world. Father, I bless the work of their hands this week. I bless the ideas that will come to them. I bless the decisions they will make. I bless the paths they will take. I bless their going out and their coming in. I bless their business transactions and their academic endeavors and their ministerial activities. I bless everything their hands will touch this week. Let the blessing of the Lord make you rich and he adds no sorrow with it. That is the kind of blessing I'm declaring. Blessed without sorrow. Blessed without regret. Blessed without compromise. Blessed in the fullness of the covenant that was purchased at Calvary. Father, I thank you for hearing this prayer. I thank you that even before we called you answered. I thank you that as we speak into the atmosphere you are working behind the scenes. You are working in hearts. You are working in situations. You are working in invisible places that will produce visible [music] results. Father, we trust you. We rely on you. We lean not on our own understanding but in all our ways we acknowledge you. And we trust you to direct our paths. [music] And we declare and we believe that this week is different. This week is marked. This week is [music] anointed. This week belongs to God. In the name of Jesus we have prayed. In the name of Jesus we have declared. In the name of Jesus we have broken every chain and opened every door and every blessing. We receive it by faith. We do not wait to see to believe it. We believe it first and then we see it. For we walk by faith and not by sight. Somebody shout hallelujah. Give God a praise for everything he has already done and for everything he's about to do. Lift your hands and tell him thank you. Thank you, Lord. Thank you for the blessing. Thank you for the favor. Thank you for the grace. Thank you for the open doors. Thank you for the breakthrough. Thank you for the miracle that is already on its way. >> [music] >> You are faithful. You are faithful. You are faithful. And to you alone be all the glory and all the honor and all the praise from this moment forward and forevermore. In Jesus mighty and matchless name we have prayed. Amen. Amen. Amen.
